images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single continuous Gothic stone wall facade for a vertically scrolling 2D side-view game. Reference is ONLY for approved crisp richly textured pixel-art style, navy/teal shadows and warm golden highlights. Generate ONE isolated long narrow FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC facade, transparent surroundings, about 1 unit wide and 3.5 units tall (use portrait canvas, wall narrow inside). It is a complete coherent continuous masonry elevation with three tall COMPLETE pointed blind arches stacked vertically, each arch containing dark blue/teal recessed masonry, no bright glass. Two slender continuous gold-brown stone pilasters frame the facade from top to bottom. Arch crowns are symmetrical, both halves complete, each pair of jambs meeting a proper lintel base. Upper capital/crown, middle vertical stone wall, small bottom footing. Main masonry is deep midnight blue with muted teal stone faces; golden worn sandstone trim. No horizontal platform projections, no balconies, no detached pieces. Moderate irregular weathering, restrained relief, small cracks, larger stone blocks, clear structure. Flat frontal elevation, no perspective or visible side faces. Straight vertical left edge. Outer right edge mostly straight with a few subtle chipped stones, no square holes, no stair step cutout. Entire wall continuous and solid inside outline, no transparent cutouts through wall. No vines, tree, character, sky, moon, text, ground plane or cast shadows outside silhouette. At final game resolution256x896 this must read as three complete architectural bays, not noisy texture. All art fits within the narrow complete facade. Keep highlights restrained so game characters remain readable.
